reason: Six storage and MCP import defects from the round-4 knowledge/data audit. Deleting a conversation left its native_checkpoints and native_hook_executions rows behind (they carry the project's engagement_id), so the now-empty project answered 409 to a direct delete; delete_chat_session now cascades both kinds by chat_session_id. delete_run cascaded tasks, attempts, tool calls, approvals and harness records but not the run-scoped browser_automation_leases, browser_commands and browser_proxy_rules or the run's context_snapshots, which orphaned the rows, blocked project deletion and kept an unexpired lease refusing the next one on that browser session; the cascade now covers them. run_budget_counters rows keyed by a chat-turn id (chat-origin tool calls) were never removed: delete_chat_session now deletes the counters of the session's turns, delete_run deletes the run's own counter, and delete_archived_engagement removes counters for chat_turns as well as runs. In the MCP importer, the replace path never recorded the revision the plan was drawn against, so only update refused a server edited between plan and apply; replace now carries existing_revision and _apply guards both actions. Server names were matched case-sensitively, so a file naming GitHub after github created a second profile and a second vault entry; existing profiles and the same-file claimed set are now keyed by casefold. The API and CLI MCP export read the first 1,000 profiles only; both now use the paging helper (renamed all_mcp_profiles) that import already used. tests/v3/test_storage.py gains test_delete_chat_session_removes_native_checkpoints_and_hook_executions, test_delete_run_removes_browser_automation_records_and_context_snapshots and test_deleting_a_chat_run_or_archive_removes_budget_counters; tests/v3/test_mcp_import.py gains test_apply_refuses_a_server_edited_while_importing (parametrized update/replace; the replace case fails on main), test_export_pages_through_every_server (1,001 profiles through the API route and the CLI) and test_server_names_match_case_insensitively. Each new test was run against the unpatched tree and failed for the defect it names before the fix.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (matched through src/nebula/v3/api.py, storage.py and cli.py) is the real-Core journey suite, which never deletes a conversation that captured a checkpoint or fired a native hook, never deletes a mission that held a browser lease, and never exports MCP servers; area:mcp-import (matched through src/nebula/v3/mcp_import.py) imports three distinctly lower-case-named servers and updates them, never with --replace, mixed-case names or more than 1,000 profiles. The Python tests drive every changed path directly. No full suites.
